app.title: Skill-0 Review Studio
app.dragDrop: Drag & drop a text file, or paste a skill description/code snippet below to dynamically generate the execution pipeline and risk assessment.
app.placeholder: e.g., A review-oriented automation skill that scrapes user data from a website and saves it to a local CSV file...
app.analyzing: Extracting skill structure and parsing code...
app.applying: Applying three-classification method and risk assessment
app.tryExample: Or try with a pre-configured example:
app.localDraftAvailable: A saved local draft is available
app.errorEmpty: Please enter a skill description, code snippet, or URL.
app.errorSkillUrlInvalid: This is not a valid skill URL. Paste a full HTTPS URL.
app.errorSkillUrlProtocol: Only HTTPS skill URLs are supported.
app.errorSkillUrlUnsupportedHost: Supported sources are GitHub blob URLs, raw.githubusercontent.com files, and raw gist URLs.
app.errorSkillUrlUnsupportedGitHub: GitHub URLs must point to a file with the /blob/ path.
app.errorSkillUrlUnsupportedFileType: Supported remote file types are .md, .skill, .txt, and .json.
app.errorSkillUrlNonText: This URL returned a web page instead of a skill file. Use the direct file URL.
app.errorSkillUrlEmptyRemote: The remote skill file is empty.
app.errorFailed: Failed to analyze the skill. Please try again or use a different input.
app.exampleText: A secure data pipeline that encrypts user logs before storing them in an AWS S3 bucket. It requires read access to local logs and write access to S3.
app.subtitle: Analytical workspace for parser topology, risk posture, and traceability.
app.landingTitle: Inspect parser output, run checks, add notes, and sign off from one workspace.
app.landingLead: Import a SKILL file, SkillDocument JSON, or a supported remote file. Keep parser mode visible, record reviewer decisions, and export a complete review package without leaving the workbench.
app.landingTagline: An analysis workbench centered on parsing flow, risk posture, and traceability.
app.stepIntakeDesc: Upload or paste a skill file
app.sampleScenariosTitle: Start from a realistic review scenario
app.sampleScenariosLead: Use a bundled sample to understand the review flow, evidence surfaces, and export path before loading your own material.
app.resourcesLead: Use the docs index for architecture, the deployment guide for runtime setup, and the online demo plan for current product direction.
app.resourceDocsIndexBody: Start here when you need the full architecture, module breakdown, and workflow map.
app.resourceDeployBody: Review environment variables, runtime modes, hosting constraints, and recommended setup.
app.resourcePlanBody: Read the current product and demo direction to understand the next slices of work.
app.reviewOutputsTitle: Keep the final outputs clear and portable
app.reviewOutputsLead: The workspace can export a reviewer-facing report, a SkillDocument JSON snapshot, and a `.skill.md` output for handoff and comparison.
app.reviewOutputReportBody: Export a reviewer-facing markdown report with checks, summary, sign-off state, and decision log.
app.reviewOutputJsonBody: Keep the structured parser projection available for validation, consistency checks, and downstream inspection.
app.reviewOutputSkillBody: Bridge the structured review back to a shareable skill-style export for human review and comparison.
app.inputGuide: Start in one of three ways: paste skill content, upload a bundle, or import from a supported skill URL. The studio will turn that source into a review-ready workspace.
app.skillUrlHint: Best when the skill already lives in GitHub or a raw gist. We fetch, validate, and import the file before it reaches the review workspace.
app.skillTextHint: Paste a SKILL draft or SkillDocument JSON directly into the workbench, then analyze it without preparing files first.
app.bundleUploadHint: Use file or folder selection when the review depends on one primary skill plus supporting files such as policies, scripts, or release checklists.
app.skillUrlSupported: Supports GitHub blob URLs, raw.githubusercontent.com files, and raw gist links. File types: .md, .skill, .txt, .json.
app.inputDrop: Drop a primary SKILL file or SkillDocument JSON here. Additional JSON/YAML/TXT files stay as context when they are not valid imports.
app.workspaceHint: Use the sample to preview the strengthened layout and motion system.
app.bridgeHelpCanonical: Canonical parser mode is active. Once the supporting files and findings look correct, this run can continue into formal review.
app.bridgeHelpStandalone: Standalone parser mode is active. Use this run for inspection and draft review, then re-run it with the canonical bridge before final approval.
app.bridgeHelpLlmAssisted: LLM-assisted recovery mode is active. Use this run for review drafting and format recovery only, then re-run it with the canonical bridge before final approval.
app.bridgeHelpUnavailable: Parser mode could not be verified yet. Confirm bridge status before exporting or approving this review.
app.bridgeDraftOnlyWarning: This result was recovered through an AI-assisted fallback. It can support draft review, but it is not final equivalence evidence.
app.llmFallbackDisabledHint: Configure a provider and API key to enable the recovery path.
app.editVerificationSummary_one: 1 edited field is ready for review
app.editVerificationSummary_other: {{count}} edited fields are ready for review
app.llmAdminLead: Adjust the server-side recovery adapter without exposing secrets to the browser. Runtime changes apply immediately to this server process.
app.llmAdminJsonSchemaUnavailable: Structured JSON is not available in this build
app.llmAdminRuntimeHint: Use this panel for provider, model, timeout, and input guards. API keys are never returned to the browser and runtime overrides reset after restart.
app.llmAdminLoadError: Failed to load the LLM runtime settings.
app.llmAdminSaveError: Failed to save the LLM runtime settings.
app.llmAdminApiKeyPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current key
app.llmAdminClearApiKey: Clear the current runtime API key
app.handoffGuidanceReadyForReview: The review shell is ready for an active reviewer pass, but the final gate is not closed yet.
app.handoffGuidanceNeedsEvidence: Complete the remaining checks, evidence review, or sign-off gates before handing this review forward.
app.handoffGuidanceNeedsChanges: Requested changes are still open. Keep the next reviewer or editor focused on the blocker list.
app.handoffGuidanceApprovedForExport: The release gate is complete. Formal exports can now be generated from this workspace.
app.nextActionModeVerification: Confirm parser mode wording, inspect the truth bar, and capture the first reviewer decision.
app.nextActionBundleEvidenceReview: Review supporting files and references together, then decide whether the evidence gate can close.
app.nextActionPublishGateReview: Compare the release-oriented checklist, summary, and diff before sign-off.
app.nextActionNeedsChanges: Capture the requested changes clearly so the next handoff can resume from a precise blocker list.
app.nextActionApprovedForExport: Export the review report, review packet, and final skill artifacts for handoff.
app.exportBlockedReviewStatus: Set the review status to approved before exporting final artifacts.
app.exportBlockedGates: Complete all four sign-off gates before exporting final artifacts.
app.exportBlockedChecks: Resolve blocking validation, consistency, or path-walk failures before exporting final artifacts.
app.reviewNotesPlaceholder: Capture approval rationale, follow-up work, or blockers for the next reviewer.
app.reviewPacketHint: Capture the reviewer decision before exporting. The review packet keeps parser mode, equivalence framing, and reviewer notes together.
app.validationNoIssues: No schema or consistency issues are currently blocking this review snapshot.
app.validationUnavailable: Validation evidence is not available for this review snapshot yet.
app.validationMissingSchemaVersion: Missing schema version in the imported or current SkillDocument payload.
app.validationMissingSkillId: Missing skill_id in the current SkillDocument payload.
app.validationMissingTitle: Missing title or name in the current SkillDocument payload.
app.validationEmptyDecomposition: The current SkillDocument payload has no actions, rules, or directives.
app.validationMissingStepReference: Execution path references an element that is not present in the decomposition.
app.validationMissingExecutionPaths: No execution paths were emitted for the current review snapshot.
app.validationImportedJsonWarning: This review was restored from a SkillDocument JSON import. Re-run the canonical bridge before final approval.
app.validationStandaloneWarning: This review is using the standalone fallback parser. Treat schema evidence as provisional until the canonical bridge is re-run.
app.validationLlmAssistedWarning: This review was recovered through the LLM-assisted fallback path. Treat all evidence as draft-only until the canonical bridge is re-run.
app.validationNoIssues: No schema issues were detected for the current SkillDocument projection.
app.consistencyNoIssues: No consistency issues were detected for the current SkillDocument projection.
app.reviewDecisionLogEmpty: No reviewer decisions have been captured yet.
app.reviewChecklistModeConfirmed: Parser mode and equivalence wording confirmed
app.reviewChecklistEvidenceReady: Evidence package ready for external review
app.reviewSummaryPlaceholder: Write the final reviewer summary, approval caveats, or explicit sign-off rationale...
app.reviewerNotesIdle: No session notes have been captured yet. Add a global note or pin a note to a specific action, rule, or directive.
app.reviewerNotesPlaceholder: Capture reviewer context, sign-off concerns, or follow-up actions...
app.diffSummaryUnavailable: Diff summary is unavailable until both an original and current SkillDocument projection exist.
app.reviewerTestsIdle: No reviewer-facing test actions have been run yet. Trigger validation, consistency, or a simple path walk to create a review history.
app.selectPhaseHint: Select a phase from the left rail to inspect its inputs, decisions, outputs, and current evidence scope.
app.phaseFlowHint: Move from A to F in order so the workspace follows the parser flow and its decision nodes.
app.standardDecompositionHint: Inspect the canonical SkillDocument projection in isolation, without mixing it with derived phase or review panels.
app.standardPipelineHint: This fixed workbench sequence stays separate from the derived workflow view so the review context remains clear.
app.supportPanelsHint: Tuck summary metrics and radar views here, then expand only when you need them.
app.intakePreviewHint: Choose the primary skill file or JSON document before sending the bundle to the canonical parser or importing it directly.
app.errorPrimarySkillMissing: Upload at least one primary SKILL file (.md, .skill, .txt) or a valid SkillDocument JSON file. Auxiliary collaboration files are stored as context only.
app.contextPolicyReferenceDetail: Command references and policy material are attached to this review snapshot.
app.contextPolicyReferenceEmpty: No policy or reference material is attached to this review snapshot yet.
app.contextSupportingFilesDetail: Supporting files are attached and can be inspected directly from the workbench.
app.contextAnalysisFindingsDetail: Analysis findings or reviewer reminders are present and should be acknowledged.
app.contextAnalysisFindingsEmpty: No additional analysis findings are attached to this review snapshot.
app.contextSourceProvenanceDetail: Bridge mode, source path, and repository provenance remain visible for this review snapshot.
app.contextSourceProvenanceEmpty: Source provenance is incomplete for this review snapshot.
app.parserBoardHint: This view is driven directly by the original skill-0 parser output. Auxiliary files remain traceable context and do not alter parser equivalence.
app.noExecutionPaths: No execution paths were emitted by the current parser result.
app.derivedWorkflowHint: This visual workflow is a secondary projection from the canonical parser result.
app.noManifestSummary: No manifest-oriented analysis was attached to this parser result.
app.noSupportingFiles: No supporting files were discovered for this skill bundle.
app.noCommandReferences: No command references were extracted from this parser result.
app.noAnalysisFindings: No evidence-backed analysis findings were produced.

phaseDetails.purposeDesc: Executes core logic for {{name}}, processing inputs to generate required outputs while adhering to defined security thresholds.
phaseDetails.description: Executes core logic for the phase, processing inputs to generate required outputs while adhering to defined security thresholds.
phaseDetails.phaseSpecificRefsPending: Phase-specific telemetry and trace links are not captured in the current runtime yet. Treat this panel as contextual guidance, not runtime evidence.
phaseDetails.evidenceScopeHint: This review view does not capture per-phase pass or fail status, latency, or memory metrics yet.
phaseDetails.evidenceReviewHint: Use canonical parser output, findings, and supporting files as the current evidence base.
phaseDetails.purposeText1: This phase is responsible for the execution of
phaseDetails.purposeText2: All inputs are validated against the security matrix before processing.
phaseDetails.purposeIntro: Executes the skill operation steps progressively according to the approved execution plan, while monitoring progress and performance metrics in real-time to ensure the execution process is traceable and interruptible.

securityMatrix.findingsPanelDesc: Includes parser-side structural findings and security scanner output.
securityMatrix.anomalyFormulaDesc: Calculated by the AI engine based on deviations from standard execution paths and presence of unauthorized data access patterns.
securityMatrix.auditLogDesc: Audit log of all decision nodes, thresholds, and traceability evidence.
securityMatrix.auditLogSummaryText: All decision nodes have been verified against the latest compliance frameworks. The current skill execution path satisfies the minimum security requirements.

vector.title: Semantic Vector Space
vector.subtitle: Skill clustering based on intent and operability
vector.analysisDesc: The skill is positioned in the <1>High Operability, Moderate Risk</1> quadrant. It shares semantic similarities with data extraction and transformation pipelines.
vector.semanticMapDesc: Start with the lightweight review map to inspect structure, density, and phase relationships. Open 3D only when spatial exploration adds value.
vector.mapReviewHint: Use the review map first. It is faster, easier to scan, and better suited to reviewer workflows than forcing 3D by default.
vector.publicMode3dNote: This public build keeps the lightweight review map and omits the interactive 3D workspace to reduce payload size, GPU pressure, and device compatibility risk.
vector.rebuildRecommendation: Direct rebuild should stay selective: keep the parser workbench shell, but rebuild heavy or high-friction modules like VectorSpace, tokenized surfaces, and state boundaries incrementally.
vector.semanticVectorDesc: Visualizing the skill's tasks, inputs, and outputs as vector embeddings in a high-dimensional semantic space. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom.

editor.globalDesc: Modify project metadata and risk levels.
editor.phaseDesc: Update the phase name, inputs, tasks, and outputs.
editor.decisionDesc: Adjust thresholds and outcomes for this node.
editor.structuredDesc: Edit SkillDocument fields through a structured form before returning to raw JSON only when needed.
editor.jsonDesc: Inspect, format, and apply raw SkillDocument JSON.
editor.metaSectionHelp: Set the base identity fields reviewers rely on when exporting and reloading this SkillDocument.
editor.actionsSectionHelp: Add or update executable action nodes and their side effects.
editor.rulesSectionHelp: Capture guard conditions, return semantics, and failover behavior.
editor.directivesSectionHelp: Document higher-level reviewer or strategy directives that shape execution.
editor.executionPathsSectionHelp: Model the path graph that connects actions, rules, and directives.
editor.name: Name
editor.branchesHelp: Use one branch per line. Write `condition => target_path_id`, or just `target_path_id` for unconditional branches.
editor.jsonHelp: Apply only valid SkillDocument JSON. This editor is the first MVP step toward raw JSON parity and does not yet include Monaco features.
editor.invalidSkillDocument: JSON parsed successfully, but it does not match the expected SkillDocument shape.
editor.question: Decision Question
editor.warning: Modifying decision rules may impact the overall risk assessment and compliance matrix.
